tweet.text:
Just wondering… has anyone actually connected Grok Bot to their bank account yet?

I’m seriously thinking about doing it.

My thinking is… if Grok Bot can see everything coming in and going out, track spending, move money, pay bills, watch for weird charges, and help me make smarter decisions… at what point do I even need a personal banker?

My significant other is telling me ABSOLUTELY NOT bc she thinks something bad could happen if I give an AI that much access.

I personally think this is where everything is headed anyway and I trust Grok Bot to do a much better job.

LMK.
